literal: Shining O jeweled one! Today if I forget, my shoulder upon ornaments will slip off, beauty having left.
translation: O friend with shining jewels! If I forget him today, my beauty will forsake me and the bangles will slip from my shoulders.
modern: ஒளிரும் அணிகலன்களை அணிந்த தோழியே! இன்று நான் அவரை மறந்தால், என் அழகு என்னை விட்டு நீங்கும்; என் தோள்களில் உள்ள வளையல்களும் கழன்று விழும்.
explanation: The heroine speaks to her friend, addressing her as one wearing shining jewels. She declares that she cannot forget her lover even for a moment. If she were to forget him today, she would instantly waste away in sorrow, causing her natural beauty to vanish and her bangles to slip from her thinning arms. The physical slipping of ornaments vividly illustrates the immediate physical toll of emotional separation.
